He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn Tigers]] and was selected by the [[Detroit Pistons]] with the 37th overall pick in the [[2021 NBA draft]]. ==Early life== Thor was born in [[Omaha, Nebraska]], to South Sudanese parents and moved to [[Anchorage, Alaska]], at age five.{{cite web |last=Hall |first=Erik |title=JT Thor: 5 things to know about the Auburn Tigers men's basketball forward |url=https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/story/sports/college/auburn/2021/01/15/jt-thor-10-facts-auburn-mens-basketball-forward-full-name/4181394001/ |website=[[Montgomery Advertiser]] |access-date=May 10, 2021 |date=January 15, 2021}} He started playing basketball in seventh grade and competed for [[West Anchorage High School]].{{cite web |title=Hoops standout Thor named Alaska Athlete of the Week |url=https://alaskasportshall.org/2020/12/anchorage-hoops-standout-thor-named-alaska-athlete-of-the-week/ |website=Alaska Sports Hall of Fame |access-date=May 10, 2021 |date=December 7, 2020 |last1=Robinson |first1=Harlow }} At age 14, Thor moved to [[West Virginia]], where his brother lived, to attend [[Huntington Prep School]].{{cite web |last=Clemente |first=Christian |title=JT the Jokester: How JT Thor left home at 14 to pursue NBA dream |url=https://auburn.rivals.com/news/jt-the-jokester-how-jt-thor-left-home-at-14-to-pursue-nba-dream |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=May 10, 2021 |date=April 1, 2021}} After two seasons, he transferred to [[Norcross High School]] in [[Norcross, Georgia]].{{cite web |last=Vitale |first=Josh |title=Auburn basketball: JT Thor didn't eat lamb, but he did show 'next-level stuff' vs Kentucky |url=https://www.montgomeryadvertiser.com/story/sports/college/auburn/2021/02/14/auburn-basketball-jt-thor-nba-prospect-kentucky/4430311001/ |website=[[Montgomery Advertiser]] |access-date=May 10, 2021 |date=February 13, 2021}} He [[reclassification (education)|reclassified]] to the 2020 class.{{cite web |last=Fisher |first=Chris |title=Five-star forward JT Thor reclassifies to 2020 |url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/JT-Thor-reclassifies-to-2020-transfers-to-Norcross-134203144/ |website=[[247Sports]] |access-date=May 10, 2021 |date=August 5, 2019}} As a senior, Thor averaged 14.9 points and 6.6 rebounds per game, receiving all-state honors.{{cite web |last=Green |first=Tom |title=4-star forward JT Thor officially signs with Auburn |url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2020/05/4-star-forward-jt-thor-officially-signs-with-auburn.html |website=AL.com |access-date=May 10, 2021 |date=May 11, 2020}} He was a consensus four-star recruit and committed to playing college basketball for [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], choosing the Tigers over [[Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball|Oklahoma State]].{{cite magazine |last=Lancaster |first=Zach |title=JT Thor Commits to Auburn, One Spot Remaining for Boynton and Co. |url=https://www.si.com/college/oklahomastate/basketball/jt-thor-commits-auburn |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |access-date=May 10, 2021 |date=April 12, 2020}} ==College career== On February 13, 2021, Thor recorded a freshman season-high 24 points and nine rebounds, shooting 5-of-6 from three-point range, in an 82–80 loss to [[2020–21 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]].{{cite web |last=Green |first=Tom |title=JT Thor shows 'next-level' ability against Kentucky |url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2021/02/jt-thor-shows-next-level-ability-against-kentucky.html |website=AL.com |access-date=May 11, 2021 |date=February 14, 2021}} As a freshman at Auburn, he averaged 9.4 points, five rebounds and 1.4 blocks per game.{{cite web |last=Polacheck |first=Jacob |title=Auburn's J.T. Thor to test NBA Draft waters |url=https://www.zagsblog.com/2021/03/23/auburns-j-t-thor-to-test-nba-draft-waters/ |website=Zagsblog |access-date=May 11, 2021 |date=March 23, 2021}} On March 23, 2021, Thor declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web |title=Auburn freshman JT Thor announces NBA Draft plans |url=https://www.saturdaydownsouth.com/auburn-football/jt-thor-nba-draft-2021-auburn-tigers-basketball/ |website=Saturday Down South |access-date=May 11, 2021 |date=March 23, 2021}} He later signed with an [[sports agent|agent]], forgoing his remaining eligibility.{{cite web |last=King |first=Nathan |title=JT Thor signs with agency, won't return to Auburn |url=https://247sports.com/college/auburn/Article/jt-thor-auburn-nba-draft-2021-tigers-basketball-bruce-pearl-sharife-cooper-walker-kessler-wendell-green-jr-166145584/ |website=[[247Sports]] |access-date=June 6, 2021 |date=June 5, 2021}} ==Professional career== ===Charlotte Hornets (2021–2024)=== Thor was selected 37th overall by the [[Detroit Pistons]] in the [[2021 NBA draft]]. On August 6, he was traded to the [[Charlotte Hornets]] with [[Mason Plumlee]] for the 57th overall pick.{{cite web|first=Jonathan|last=DeLong|title=Hornets select JT Thor with the 37th overall pick|url=https://www.atthehive.com/2021/7/29/22601289/charlotte-hornets-select-jt-thor-with-the-37th-overall-pick-2021-nba-draft|website=AtTheHive.com|date=July 29, 2021|access-date=July 30, 2021|archive-date=July 30, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210730035410/https://www.atthehive.com/2021/7/29/22601289/charlotte-hornets-select-jt-thor-with-the-37th-overall-pick-2021-nba-draft|url-status=dead}}{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Acquire Mason Plumlee and the Draft Rights to JT Thor|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-acquire-mason-plumlee-and-draft-rights-jt-thor|website=NBA.com|date=August 6, 2021|access-date=July 12, 2024}} The Hornets officially signed Thor on August 6, 2021.{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Sign Second-Round Selection JT Thor|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/press-releases/charlotte-hornets-sign-second-round-selection-jt-thor|website=NBA.com|date=August 6, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}} On October 26 and November 2, he was assigned to the [[Greensboro Swarm]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|title=Hornets Assign Vernon Carey Jr. and JT Thor to Greensboro Swarm|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/hornets-assign-vernon-carey-jr-and-jt-thor-to-greensboro-swarm/n-5760591|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 2, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}} In his G League debut, Thor posted 34 points off of 14-of-22 shooting and grabbed 12 rebounds in a 128–117 loss to the [[Birmingham Squadron]].{{cite news|first=Zac|last=Blackerby|title=Former Auburn Tiger JT Thor has strong night in NBA G League debut|url=https://auburnwire.usatoday.com/2021/11/06/former-auburn-tiger-jt-thor-has-strong-night-in-nba-g-league-debut/|work=Auburn Wire|date=November 6, 2021|access-date=November 7, 2021}} The Hornets released Thor on June 28, 2024, along with guard [[Seth Curry]].{{cite news|first=Roderick|last=Boone|title=Charlotte Hornets cut two players one day after NBA Draft as roster reconstruction begins|url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/charlotte-hornets/article289620760.html|work=[[The Charlotte Observer]]|date=July 1, 2024|access-date=August 17, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240817172028/https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/charlotte-hornets/article289620760.html|archive-date=August 17, 2024|url-status=live}} ===Cleveland Cavaliers (2024–2025)=== On September 9, 2024, Thor signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign JT Thor to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/releases-jt-thor-two-way-240909|website=NBA.com|date=September 9, 2024|access-date=September 10, 2024}} On March 1, 2025, the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] waived Thor.{{Cite web|title=JT Thor: Cut loose by Cleveland|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/jt-thor-cut-loose-by-cleveland/|access-date=March 30, 2025|website=cbssports.com|language=en}} ===Washington Wizards (2025)=== On March 3, 2025, Thor was claimed off waivers by the [[Washington Wizards]].{{Cite web|title=Washington Claims JT Thor Off Waivers|url=https://www.nba.com/wizards/news/washington-claims-jt-thor-off-waivers|access-date=March 5, 2025|website=nba.com|language=en}} He made 11 appearances for Washington, averaging 3.9 points, 3.8 rebounds, and 0.5 assists. ===Pallacanestro Reggiana (2025–present)=== On November 11, 2025, Thor signed [[Pallacanestro Reggiana]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]].{{cite web | last=Adams | first=Luke | title=JT Thor Signs With Reggio Emilia | website=Hoops Rumors | date=2025-11-11 | url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2025/11/jt-thor-signs-with-reggio-emilia.html | access-date=2025-12-06}}
